- Game 2 (Ravens at Wolves, typed): Wolves 50, Ravens 45, "No statistics were recorded for this game."

## What stopped or slowed the walk

- Step 19 (and the plan's "as a visitor"): Still Waters is a draft league, so a signed-out visitor gets "Page not found" on every page. WENT ROUND: the public pages are read as the owner; the test checks the 404 "known until step 2.125, part 2". For the lead: the founder cannot do the visitor part of Test 1 until a league can be published (2.125 part 2), or Still Waters starts live.
- Steps 16 and 18 (fixed here, seed only): the empty league's season carried the old seed's statistics (points, rebounds, fouls), so its statistics page had a Rebounds column and card that no game there can record, and its box scores had no 3PM or FTM. `stand-in-world-seed.ts` now gives that one season no statistics of its own, as a season made today has; no other league moves.
- Step 10: with the default rules (standard set) the team turnover shows only on the tracker's chip and as "Turnover by Wolves" in the play by play; no box score Total or statistic shows it (no TO column). The plan's "reads it in the team's Total" cannot be done without the full set. WENT ROUND: first-test.md says where it shows and why. For the lead: decide whether the walk should switch the season to the full set (no screen for that that I found).
- Step 18: under each leader card the list ranks players with 0 ("2. Ann Ravens 0.0" under 3-pointers made). Reads oddly; first-test.md warns the founder. One line for a parked statistics step.
- Step 6: nothing to do; the season starts shown, and the screen says truly that visitors cannot see the league until it is published. Not a fault.
- Step 7 (wish, not a fault): the home page's cards and the tracker put the teams in different orders (card "Wolves vs Ravens", end question "Ravens 7, Wolves 6"); first-test.md names the game by its time.
- Step 13: in the test the taps take a second, so the question reads "H2 still has 20:00"; the founder's will show real time left.

## Technical choices

- The tracker runs in a scripts-on touch context; the admin in a scripts-off one; the sign-in page's cookie is carried across, so it is one signed-in owner.
- Game rows in Admin → Games are found by their `game-<id>` anchor (game 1's id from the tracker's address).
- B2 pins with explicit values (not snapshots: ids are new each run).
- `--say` prints each screen's words and `--shots=<folder>` takes three pictures, for writing first-test.md.
